secretNote.zh: 母星报告已结束调查主线。玩家可另行花费750稀有文物开启秘密研究；要求已发现母星且此前未开启。工程研究项目无期限，完成后收到秘密报告，并非自动发生。
secretNote.en: The homeworld report ends the investigation. Separately spend 750 minor artifacts to start this optional engineering project; the homeworld must be found and research not previously started. It has no time limit and does not begin automatically.

investigationNote.zh: 地点没有固定先后；各项目要求科学家带领的科研船，基础研究时间180天。累计六份完成报告后定位母星。
investigationNote.en: Investigate in any order. Each project requires a science ship with a scientist and has a base duration of 180 days. Six completed reports locate the home system.

homeworldNote.zh: 六份线索完成后定位母星。首次生成若暂缺合适星系，每30天重试；成功或已存在时，两天后收到通知。之后仍须完成母星调查。
homeworldNote.en: After six clues, locate the home system. If initial placement lacks a suitable system, retry every 30 days; successful placement or an existing system produces the notice after 2 days. The homeworld project still follows.

arrivalNote.zh: 母星项目基础30天，要求科学家带领的科研船。完成时若尚无母星发现标志且目标未殖民，进入完整报告；否则进入另一结果。两者互斥，星系被定位并不等于母星已被调查。
arrivalNote.en: The homeworld project takes 30 base days and requires a science ship with a scientist. On completion, the full report requires no homeworld-found flag and an uncolonized target; otherwise the alternative applies. Locating the system is not completing its investigation.

secretNote.zh: 首次秘密研究后，仅常规帝国的狂热唯物视角可继续深入。选择公开或压制会改变五天后各结果的权重；科学家须仍存在。三种后果互斥，不依次发生。
secretNote.en: Only the fanatic materialist perspective of a regular empire can pursue further research. Publishing or suppressing the findings changes the outcome weights after five days; the scientist must still exist. The three outcomes are alternatives.

investigationLabels.zh: 双人冷冻室与医疗日志
investigationLabels.en: Two cryo chambers and medical logs

investigationNote.zh: 九处地点可任意顺序调查；每项基础180天，要求科研船与科学家。收集六份报告后定位母星；额外资源回调不算另一份线索。
investigationNote.en: Investigate the nine sites in any order. Each project takes a base 180 days and requires a science ship and scientist. Six reports locate the home system; the extra resource callback is not another clue.

arrivalNote.zh: 母星项目基础30天，要求科研船与科学家。完成时尚无尤特母星发现标志且目标未殖民，进入完整报告；否则进入另一结果，两者互斥。
arrivalNote.en: The homeworld project takes a base 30 days and requires a science ship and scientist. The full report requires no Yuht homeworld-found flag and an uncolonized target at completion; otherwise the alternative applies.

homeworldNote.zh: 六份线索完成后定位母星。首次生成若暂缺合适星系，每30天重试；成功或找到已有星系时，两天后收到通知。通知结束线索搜集并开启母星调查项目，尚不代表调查完成。
homeworldNote.en: Six clues locate the home system. If initial placement has no suitable system, it retries every 30 days. Successful placement or an existing system leads to a notice after two days. The notice ends clue collection and opens the homeworld project; investigation is still required.

secretNote.zh: 另行花费750稀有文物开启，要求已发现尤特母星且尚未开始该研究。社会学项目无期限；完成报告按思潮与科技资格显示互斥正文和奖励回应。
secretNote.en: Spend 750 minor artifacts separately after finding the Yuht homeworld, provided this research has not already been started. The society project has no expiration. Its report and reward depend on ethics and technology eligibility.
